name: talk-to-figma-mcp
description: Lets Claude Desktop read, inspect and edit Figma files through a local relay and the Talk to Figma plugin. Works with free Figma accounts; Dev Mode is not required.

figma_personal_token.title: Figma personal access token (optional)
figma_personal_token.description: Optional. Enables REST API tools (rest_get_file, rest_render_image, rest_get_comments, rest_post_comment) that read and render ANY Figma file by URL without the plugin open. Create one in Figma → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens. Leave blank to use plugin-based tools only.
